observations.audio: Speaker A (older female voice) begins: 'All right. And here's what the function design is supposed to be.' Around 63s a second female voice (Speaker C) starts overlapping: 'And it should have multiple purpose, like the remote control which we use for TV…'. Overlap present from ~63s; no silence, no clipping/pop.
observations.visual: Four-panel grid. Top-left = Participant A (short grey hair, glasses, red top over cream turtleneck); top-right = panel labelled '林岚 / Francina'; bottom-left = Participant C (dark hair, maroon top); bottom-right = Participant D (white hair, glasses, light blue top). All four faces fully visible with no blur/mask; all name labels legible and unobstructed. No picture-in-picture, no replay indicator. Static bottom overlay banner present (experiment caption), not occluding any face.
observations.uncertainty: Overlap beginning makes the exact A/C word boundary uncertain; speaker IDs inferred from voice timbre and matching lip movement in A's panel only.

observations.audio: Overlap continues, dominated by Speaker C: '…it should be used for some other purpose also, like controlling—' (trails off). Speaker A's prior phrase has ended. Continuous speech, no silence in this window, no pop/clipping.
observations.visual: Layout switches to single large view of Participant A (mouth moving, consistent with earlier A speech / listening) plus a small picture-in-picture in the bottom-right showing '林岚 / Francina' (face visible, label visible). A's own label 'Participant A' visible bottom-left, unoccluded. No face masking anywhere.
observations.uncertainty: Because two voices overlapped just before this window, attributing the tail of the 'controlling' phrase strictly to C is probable but not certain from audio alone; PiP confirms Francina is on screen but her lip movement is too small to verify speech.

observations.audio: Speaker C's overlapping phrase finishes (~70-72s), followed by a clear silence/gap from roughly 72s to 75s. No music, no pop; just room-tone silence.
observations.visual: Four-panel grid rearranged: top-left = Participant C, top-right = Participant D, bottom-left = Participant A, bottom-right = '林岚 / Francina'; a central picture-in-picture of Francina overlays the panel intersection. The PiP partially occludes the top-row name labels (Participant D's label reads only ': D'); no faces are occluded. Bottom overlay banner present.
observations.uncertainty: Silence boundary (~72-75s) estimated from the merged track; exact onset of the gap uncertain by ±1s. PiP-induced label occlusion noted but faces remain identifiable.

observations.audio: Speaker A resumes (no overlap): 'Here's a project finance, uh, which of course we all have to think about when we design this thing.' Filler 'uh' preserved; no institution name spoken; no amount yet. No clipping.
observations.visual: Four-panel grid: top-left = '林岚 / Francina', top-right = Participant C, bottom-left = Participant D, bottom-right = Participant A. All faces visible, no masking; all four name labels fully legible (no PiP in this window). Bottom overlay banner present.
observations.uncertainty: Speaker A attribution based on voice and on A's panel lip movement; the other three participants appear to be listening.

observations.audio: Speaker A continues: 'Um, selling price is supposed to be 25 euro.' Amount '25 euro' clearly stated; filler 'Um' preserved; no negation, no institution. Speech ends ~84s, after which silence begins.
observations.visual: Single large view of Participant A (gesturing with hand near face, mouth moving) plus bottom-right picture-in-picture of '林岚 / Francina' (face and label visible). A's label 'Participant A' visible and unoccluded. No face masking.
observations.uncertainty: Transition from speech to silence around 84s is approximate; PiP Francina's lips not resolvable, so she is assumed non-speaking here.

observations.audio: Silence / room tone only for the remainder of the segment (no speech, no overlap, no pop/clipping).
observations.visual: Four-panel grid: top-left = Participant D, top-right = Participant A, bottom-left = '林岚 / Francina', bottom-right = Participant C. All faces visible with no blur or mask; all name labels legible; no PiP, no replay indicator. Bottom overlay banner present.
observations.uncertainty: None significant; segment is silent and all four participants are visibly idle/listening.
